Intent: Keep design delivery reliable without rewarding rushed screen counts
Formula: Accepted milestone deliverables completed by agreed date / milestone deliverables due
Evidence: ClickUp due dates and acceptance records
Notes: Re-baseline only when scope changes are approved by the CTO

Intent: Ensure every core learner journey is designed end to end
Formula: Critical journeys with approved flow and prototype / critical journeys in brief
Notes: All eight journeys in the product brief must be covered

Intent: Prevent implementation gaps in non-happy paths
Formula: Applicable required states documented / applicable required states identified
Notes: Safety and payment-critical states require 100% coverage

Formula: Screen elements using approved reusable components / eligible repeated screen elements
Notes: New patterns require a documented reason

Intent: Confirm that critical flows can be completed
Formula: Participants completing each critical task without facilitator rescue / participants attempting task
Review Cadence: At MVP v1 and final prototype
Evidence: Moderated test notes or structured internal test
Notes: Use at least 5 representative users when available; label internal tests separately

Intent: Prevent severe blockers from reaching handoff
Formula: Count of unresolved issues that prevent task completion or cause irreversible error
Notes: CTO and UI/UX Designer agree severity

Intent: Make core experiences usable beyond the happy path
Formula: Applicable accessibility checks passed / applicable checks performed
Evidence: Contrast results, text scaling review, touch-target and focus notes
Notes: Captions, non-color cues, readable contrast, and touch targets are critical

Intent: Give engineering enough detail to implement without guessing
Formula: Accepted handoff checklist items / required handoff checklist items
Evidence: Annotated files, tokens, component states, prototype, and acceptance record
Notes: Acceptance is by CTO after engineering review

Intent: Expose unclear behavior or missing specifications
Formula: Clarification requests caused by missing design detail / screens entering implementation
Target: No more than 10% after final handoff
Notes: Do not count genuine product changes or newly discovered technical constraints

Intent: Keep UI and brand work integrated
Formula: Milestone deliverables reviewed by Graphic Designer before approval / milestone deliverables requiring brand review
Notes: Review must happen in context, not only through exported images
